sentences.en: All in favor of this proposition will please say Aye.
sentences.zh: 所有赞成这个提议的人请说‘同意’。

sentences.en: It's no wonder that his proposition was refuted so soon.
sentences.zh: 难怪他的建议很快就被驳回了。

sentences.en: My friend came to me with a business proposition.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友来找我谈了一个商业上的提议。

senses.zh: 提议，建议；主张，观点；命题，陈述；问题，课题
